text_block_list.text: Today, I was supposed to have a meeting with Seiun Sky while exchanging New Year's greetings... or so it was planned.

I've gotten used to her whimsical nature.
Just as I was thinking of going to look for her—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pardon me!

The one who entered politely was Nishino Flower.
I recall she's a girl who often talks with Seiun Sky.
choice_data_list: What's the matter, being all by yourself?
What are you doing all by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Alone...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Jeez, Sky?!
The person Nishino Flower dragged in from the hallway was a very familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Hey there~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
First, our greetings, right?
Sky-san, ready, set...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ah!?
S-Sky-san~~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha~ sorry, sorry.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Flower looked so cute all fired up,
so I made sure to watch her closely☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh,
please stop teasing me!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ready for one more time?
Ready, set, go!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year!
Happy New Yeeeaaar.

When I talked to Nishino Flower after that...
it turned out she'd seen Seiun Sky sleeping in the courtyard,
guessed what was going on, and brought her over here.
Apparently, they really had been planning on skipping the meeting. As I held my head in exasperation—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
Sky-san isn't a bad person!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "She's just a bit easygoing, is all... She definitely didn't mean to slack off today!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll help out too, so please keep
taking good care of Sky-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Sky-san,
good luck with your meeting, okay?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, thanks a bunch.
After that, Nishino Flower bowed politely and left. But not before emphasizing, "Please take good care of Sky-san"...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...If you're going to make a face like you have something to say,
would you mind actually saying it?
choice_data_list: I was thinking how honest you are when it comes to Nishino Flower~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey, hold on!
You've got that scheming look on your face!"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, this isn't a regular thing, okay?
Flower was just so fired up today,
so I only came along to keep her company.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: So trying to use Flower as an excuse... makes no sense at all! You can't!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look!
Aren't we supposed to be having a meeting?
choice_data_list: Let's go with training after all!
Shall we have our meeting over tea?
Tell me about you and Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh~~!?!?
Even though it's New Year's!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This is tyranny!
Say no to working over New Year's!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, are you...
actually really mad that I tried to slack off?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: That's totally it~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Turns out she's the scary-when-angry Grass-chan type, huh...

And so, starting the new year full of energy!
I did some training with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nice idea!
I'll go brew some tea right away, then~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, you're way too surprised!
I can brew tea just fine, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...At awkward times like this.

Was it about her trying to slack off,
or about getting completely outmaneuvered
by Nishino Flower's pure innocence...?

"I don't get it, but Seiun Sky actually went
out of her way to make tea—"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: No way, Sei-chan would never mess up like...—Ugh, bitter!?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
choice_data_list: How did the two of you meet?
How did the two of you meet?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, just normally around the academy—
Wait, why do you wanna hear about that?"
choice_data_list: I want to know the reason behind Seiun Sky's straightforwardness.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now!
Sei-chan is always honest and upfront, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep, and that's the end of this conversation! Closed up, shutting down, see ya~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: I'm not running away! I'm just walking, see?
Afterward, a little game of chase broke out in the trainer's office...
